label: Read this page
prompt: Adopt the user's active browser tab, read it with mcp__browse__read_page, and summarise what the page is and what a user can do on it. Keep it under 150 words.

label: Accessibility pass
prompt: Read the active browser tab with mcp__browse__read_page. Report accessibility problems you can see from the accessibility tree: missing labels, poor heading order, images without alt text, controls that are not reachable. List concrete findings only — no general advice.

label: Check console
prompt: Use mcp__browse__read_console_messages on the active tab and report any errors or warnings. If there are none, say so in one line.

label: Explain this repo file
prompt: Find the file I am most likely looking at in this repository, read it, and explain what it does and how it fits into the extension. Be specific about the code paths it participates in.
